Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
REVERSIBLE HANDLES FOR CROSS CUT SAWS 



( Reaffirmed 2004 ) 



1. Scope — Specifies the material dimensions and other requirements for single grip reversible 
handles for two-men cross cut saws as per IS : 12127-1 987 'Specification for two men cross cut 

saws'. 

2. Material 

2.1 Handles — Shall be made from good quality, seasoned hard wood, such as Acacia arabica 
(Babul), Acacia catecf)u ( Khair ), Anogeissus latifolia ( Bakli ), Adina cordifolia ( Haldu ), 
Azadirecta indica { Neevn ) ^ Ougeinia dalbergioides ( Sandan ), Schleichera trij'uga ( Kusum ), 
Shorea robusta ( Sal ), and Terminalia tomentosa ( Laurel ). 

2.1.1 Wooden blanks shall be free from centre heart (pith), decay (rot), checks, shakes, 
splits, borer holes, warp, etc. 

2.2 Holding Pin, Wing Nut and Washer — ShaW be made from mild steel [ ^ee IS : 226-1975 
Structural steel ( standard quality ) ( fifth revision ) ]. 

2.3 Locking Washer — Shall be made from cast iron castings of grade FG 150 Isee IS : 210-1 978 
Grey iron castings ( third revision ) ] or from mild steel ( see IS : 226-1 975 ). 

3. Shape and Dimensions ~ Shall be as shown in Fig. 1 A to IE.

3,1 Tolerance for the dimensions shall be very coarse class specified in IS : 2102 ( Part 1 )-1980 
'General tolerances for linear and angular dimensions ( second revision )'. 

4, Other Requirements — It is recommended that, immediately after manufacture, handles shall 
be dipped in raw linseed oil at about 90°C for one hour. 

5, Workmanship and Finish — Handle pin shall be forged in single piece and shall be finished 
smooth. They shall be free from burrs, pits, sharp edges, cracks and other defects. 

5,1 Threads shall be well formed and the threads of wing nut shall be of free class fit, whereas 
the threads of the handle pin shall be medium class fit. 



IS : 12128 - 1987 

6. Designation — Reversible handles shall be designated by its name and the number of this 
Indian Standard as: 

Reversible handle IS : 12128 

7. Marking — Each handle shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark, if any and the batch or code number. 

7,1 Standard Mark — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Packing — Shall be as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 

9. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser, the sampling 
plan and criteria for conformity shall be as given in Appendix A. 



APPENDIX A 

( Clause 9 ) 

SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 

A-1. Scale of Sampling 

A-1-1 Lot — In any consignment all the handles of the same grade and nominal size manufactured 
under similar conditions of manufacture shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. 

A-1. 2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lotto the requirements of this specification, tests 
shall be carried out on the handles selected from each lot separately. The number of handles to 
be selected at random from a lot shall be in accordance with col 1 and 2 of Table 1 . To ensure 
the randomness of selection, the procedure as laid down in IS : 4905*1968 'Methods for random 
sampling' may be followed. 

TABLE 1 SAMPLING SIZE AND PERMISSIBLE NUMBER OF DEFECTIVES 

(C/auses A-1. 2 a/jc/A-2.1.1 ) 

Lot Size Sample Size Permissible Number 

of Defectives 

(1) (2) (3) 

Up to 50 5 

51 to 150 8 

151 to 300 13 1 

301 to 500 20 2 

501 and above 32 3 

A-2. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity 

A-2.1 The handles selected according to A-1 -2 shall be examined for material (seeZ), 
dimensions ( see 3 ) and general requirements { see 4 ). Any handle failing to meet the require- 
ments for any one or more of the characteristics mentioned above shall be declared defective. 

A-2.1.1 The lot shall be considered conforming to the requirements of the characteristics 
mentioned in A-2.1 if the number of handles found defective is less than or equal to the 
corresponding number given in col 3 of Table 1 . 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Single grip reversible handles are used with two-men cross cut saws used for felling and 
bucking of trees of diameter more than 200 mm. 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from the Logging Development 
Division, Forest Research Institute and College, Dehra Dun.
